cards.title: Partner's Behavior at Kids' Sports Events
cards.body: A long-term partner's aggressive conduct at sons' football matches is affecting the relationship. An advice columnist suggests exploring the root cause of this anger rather than dismissing it outright.

cards.title: Human Connection More Critical Than AI for Kids
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection poses a greater threat to children than technology itself. Open conversation between parents and children is key to countering screen-related concerns.

cards.title: Making Halloween Magic for Your Kids
cards.body: A parent decides to embrace Halloween celebrations as an opportunity for family connection and wonder. Creating autumn traditions can transform cynicism into meaningful moments with children.

cards.title: Why Older Siblings Matter During Adolescence
cards.body: Older siblings influence younger siblings in ways parents often cannot, serving as trusted role models and mentors. This sibling relationship is particularly valuable during the teenage years.

cards.title: Supporting Parents of Excessively Crying Infants
cards.body: When babies cry excessively, parents often struggle emotionally and physically. New research emphasizes that parent-focused support is just as important as addressing the infant's crying.

cards.title: Protein Powders Safe for Pre-Teens and Teens?
cards.body: Parents question whether protein supplements are appropriate for younger athletes or if whole foods like steak are sufficient. Experts weigh in on safety and necessity for pre-teens and teenagers.
